t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Click S and/or K as soon as the blue box appears. Click a few times to ensure I am not picked up as too slow. Press the space key as soon as the basket appears, again a few times to ensure you gather mushrooms and aren't deemed too slow. There is no pattern. It is random.

vb_textbox.text: I believe the numbers are random and there is no pattern to this. My technique was to click on gnomes with tall hats. If both gnomes had tall hats, I clicked the purple gnome. If both gnomes had small hats, I clicked the yellow gnome. I only received 0 mushrooms a few times. Be sure to click S and K as soon as the gnomes appear and click the space bar as soon as the screen moves on.
